notes: Secret Morse is now hidden behind "Tap to reveal" by default: revealing asks for your PIN or passphrase again, and the text hides itself after 30 seconds, when you leave the chat or switch apps. Turning this off also needs your PIN or passphrase.
Optional secret phrase per contact: agree on a phrase in person; it is never sent or saved, and without it nobody can decode your Secret Morse — not even someone holding your unlocked phone.
Optional burn after reading for Secret Morse: readable once, then deleted from both phones.

Your passphrase and PIN are now protected with Argon2id (memory-hard; much harder to guess with graphics cards). Existing profiles upgrade automatically the next time you unlock. New backups use Argon2id too; older backups still restore. Vault export bundles and protected Spaces still use PBKDF2 for now.
A much better strength meter (zxcvbn) when choosing a passphrase, PIN or backup passphrase.

24-word recovery phrase: show your identity as 24 words to write on paper (Settings → Security), and restore from it on a new device. This encodes your Vexunori key directly; it is not the NIP-06 seed format of some other Nostr apps.
Still experimental and untested on many real phones — please report bugs on GitHub.
